cues: Worked example six point three, the effective atomic number.
Start from the atomic number, subtract the oxidation state, and add two electrons for every ligand bond.
Ferrocyanide: twenty six minus two plus twelve, thirty six, the same as krypton.
Cobalt hexammine and nickel carbonyl also reach thirty six.
